source.name: MLB.com: Padres announce Motorola as official jersey patch partner
source.note: Club/league release, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2025-09-09 because the live mlb.com page returns 403 to scripts. It announces the patch from the 2023 season; Blinkfire Analytics' 2026 MLB jersey-patch list (2026-04-20) still lists Motorola on the Padres.
source.quote: A patch of the iconic Motorola “batwing” logo will be woven into the shoulder of the different versions of the Padres uniform.
